text: なんだよお…　はやく　あっち　いけよ！

structure.jp: はやく　あっち　いけよ！

patterns.name: 〜え (command)
patterns.explanation: Changing the last sound of a verb to an え sound turns it into a blunt order. いく becomes いけ. あっち　いけ = 'go away'.

patterns.name: 〜く (adverb)
patterns.explanation: Swapping the last い of a describing word for く makes it describe how something is done. はやく = 'quickly'.
